name: manual_e37a0b
claim: A spike/PR's own "Not in scope / follow-on" section is a load-bearing TODO list — before concluding a wiring gap is undocumented or an accidental oversight, check whether the original implementation doc already named and deferred it.

decisions.notes: PT #199's spike doc explicitly listed "wire into all dispatch paths (supervisor, fastapi_app)" under deferred follow-on work back on 2026-06-29; it sat unpicked for ~3 weeks. Treating this as a fresh discovery this session would have overstated the finding as a bug rather than a known backlog item.
